groupings.title: Code Quality
groupings.description: Refactoring verbs, architectural diagnosis, debt tracking, and the pre/post gates that keep a behaviour-preserving sweep honest.

groupings.title: Security
groupings.description: OWASP-aligned scanners — secrets in history, dependency advisories, SSRF egress sinks, the on-device mobile lane — plus STRIDE threat modelling.

groupings.title: Testing
groupings.description: Coverage gaps, mutation strength, property-based invariants, consumer-driven contracts, and test-data factories.

groupings.title: Documentation
groupings.description: Catch docs that lie — dead-symbol references, stale diagrams, unrunnable quickstarts, undocumented public API.

groupings.title: Codebase Learning
groupings.description: The deep-extraction loop /setup-project runs to learn a codebase — architecture, domain entities, flows, emergent conventions, failure history.

groupings.title: AI Engineering
groupings.description: Offline LLM eval harness detection and regression gating for RAG, prompt, and agent changes.

groupings.title: Algorithms
groupings.description: Mechanically derive time and space complexity — loop nesting, recurrences, amortized analysis — with a defensible big-O.

groupings.title: Codebase Alignment
groupings.description: Stack-conditional drift detection against a gold-standard inventory, and the per-finding DETECT-DECIDE-FIX-VERIFY loop that closes it.

groupings.title: Backend
groupings.description: API contract snapshots, endpoint verification, tenant-isolation debugging, and module scaffolding.

groupings.title: Business Logic
groupings.description: Funnel completion, cross-feature business-cycle coverage, and pricing/billing/tax correctness.

groupings.title: Database
groupings.description: Seven code-first detectors (N+1, query shape, index coverage, schema integrity, migration safety, transactions, connections), ORM-vs-reality drift, and migration rehearsal against prod-sized data.

groupings.title: DevOps
groupings.description: Dockerfile linting, GitOps reconciliation, deploy monitoring, progressive delivery, and container supply-chain gating.

groupings.title: Distributed Systems
groupings.description: Chaos injection against a running service, and safe dead-letter-queue replay.

groupings.title: Frontend
groupings.description: Code-first detectors for WCAG source defects, UI request races, routing, i18n and render correctness, plus Core Web Vitals scanners (LCP, critical path, images, fonts, SEO, SSR, navigation), bundle analysis and live Playwright verification. /frontend-audit runs them; /frontend-fix closes what they find.

groupings.title: Infrastructure
groupings.description: Terraform/Pulumi plan review, K8s and network-exposure audits, admission policy, and disaster-recovery readiness.

groupings.title: Migration (V1 to V2)
groupings.description: Per-feature V1 to V2 porting with parity guarantees — contract extraction, parity suites, data cutover, migration-time perf uplift.

groupings.title: Mobile
groupings.description: Native accessibility, lifecycle (process death, permissions, push, OTA), render and startup cost, offline sync, the dated store gates, app size, bridge auditing and platform conventions. /mobile-audit runs them; /mobile-fix closes what they find.

groupings.title: Observability
groupings.description: Alert hygiene, SLO reality-checks, and synthetic/blackbox coverage of critical user journeys.

groupings.title: Performance
groupings.description: Endpoint profiling, load campaigns, memory-leak hunting, and field Core Web Vitals with attribution.

groupings.title: UI/UX
groupings.description: UI-state coverage and the state matrix behind gate G12, design-token drift, motion and reduced-motion, chart encoding, a fast a11y pass, and the 19-verb closure vocabulary.
